name: video
description: Recipe-driven HyperFrames motion graphics: same skeleton, swap the content.

interface.shortDescription: Render a parameterized HyperFrames motion graphic from a named recipe
interface.longDescription: video owns repeatable, parameterized motion graphics. Its one skill, hf-motion, takes a recipe name and key=value parameters, scaffolds a HyperFrames project from that recipe's template, fills every on-screen string and tunable from the parameters (never inventing facts), regenerates a beat-locked music bed, then runs lint, check and snapshots through the official hyperframes plugin launcher and renders only after the parameters are confirmed. The one implemented recipe is intro-kinetic, a 15 s kinetic-typography self-introduction whose default parameters reproduce the original verified video frame for frame. Engine rules are not restated here: hf-motion requires the official hyperframes plugin and delegates to its hyperframes-core and motion-graphics skills.
defaultPrompt: Make my 15 second kinetic self-intro video with name=Hong Gildong and three flash words.
